# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>
- **Rank:** class beauty and belle  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c7 P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa has brown tints that suit dresses of creamy yellow silk and lace. On her wedding day, she makes a dainty fairy of a bride.

_Sources: [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Philippa possesses great charm and a sweet, goodhearted nature. She has a frivolous exterior with a loyal soul underneath, and is free from snobbishness. She loves being popular, enjoys having suitors as comrades, and possesses the knack of making people like her.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031)_

## History

Philippa Gordon enters Redmond College as a Freshman, quickly becoming a popular student, class beauty, and belle due to her charm and family background. She introduces Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant into Redmond's social life, and the three compete for top academic honors along with Gilbert Blythe. For a long time, she is indecisive between her two hometown suitors, Alec and Alonzo. In her second year, she moves into Patty's Place with Anne, Priscilla, Stella Maynard, and Aunt Jamesina. While spending time at Prospect Point, she meets Jonas Blake, a Redmond graduate, falls in love with him, and eventually becomes engaged to him. She devotes herself to studying mathematics in her final year, successfully overcoming her mother's objections to marrying a minister. Following graduation, she marries Jonas in Bolingbroke with Anne serving as her bridesmaid.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013), [v3 c7 P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 c7 P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_
